{{Quote|Some Republic Senators have gone on record as being concerned with the Alliance's protection measures, finding their tank droids excessive. On several occasions, Corporate Alliance executives have demonstrated that their tank droids fall within legal boundaries.|HoloNet News reporting|<ref name="HoloNet">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|business/13321_1.html|Corporate Alliance Attacks Slicer Compound}}</ref>}}
The '''Corporate Alliance Policy Administration Directorate''' were the armed forces of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. These forces were later pledged to the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] by [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]]. It consisted of both [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Koorivar Fusiliers]].

==History==
{{Quote|The Commerce Guild and the Corporate Alliance have both pledged their armies to Count Dooku and are forming a&mdash;|[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
The Corporate Alliance maintained a small security force of [[Koorivar Fusiliers]], which protected Corporate Alliance facilities against sabotage and industrial espionage. Much like the Commerce Guild, they also had a sizable force of droids, such as the infamous [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcers]]. The Corporate Alliance Policy Administration Directorate was reorganized along with other droid armies into more effective fighting forces. It was dissolved, along with most of its [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] battle droids, when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] deactivated the [[master control signal]] after [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|assassinating]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], his [[Denaria Kee/Legends|aide]], and the rest of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].

==Organization==
The command structure of the Koorivar Fusiliers was similar to that of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]], though not equal in size. The Fusiliers strength relied heavily on artillery units during battles. Each artillery emplacement was manned by two engineers and a crew leader.
*'''Regiment:''' Consisted of three battalions (972 Fusiliers plus support personnel), led by a general.
*'''Battalion:''' Consisted of three companies (324 Fusiliers plus support personnel), led by a colonel.
*'''Company:''' Consisted of three platoons (108 Fusiliers plus support personnel), led by a captain.
*'''Platoon:''' Consisted of three squads (36 Fusiliers), led by a lieutenant.
*'''Squad:''' Consisted of twelve Fusiliers, led by a sergeant.
*'''Droid Unit:''' Consisted of two-to-four [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcers]]
